en.sayed-ali-raza: You cannot offer any excuse before Allāh or before me for wilful killing
because there must be the question of revenge in it.
If you are involved in it by error and you exceed in the use of your whip or sword, or are hard in inflicting punishment,
as sometimes even a blow by the fist or a smaller stroke causes death,
then the haughtiness of your authority should not prevent you from paying the blood price to the successors of the killed person.
